Based on the image provided, here is a precise description of the bottom region of the **hyper3d.ai/workspace/rodin** page (1440px viewport):

### 1. Gallery Grid (Top Section)
This section displays a row of user-generated 3D model cards, likely the end of a community feed or gallery.
*   **Layout:** A horizontal grid containing **4 visible tiles**.
*   **Tile Aspect & Style:** The tiles are roughly square with rounded corners. Each features a high-quality render of a 3D object against a dark, atmospheric background with subtle lighting effects (volumetric/glow).
*   **Visible Content (Left to Right):**
    *   **Tile 1:** A red, stylized character resembling Deadpool. Overlay shows user "Dogmar666" and "**81 likes**".
    *   **Tile 2:** A gingerbread man figure. Overlay shows user "zqodz" and "**47 likes**".
    *   **Tile 3:** An orange robotic arm. Overlay shows user "Yago ..." and "**17 likes**".
    *   **Tile 4:** A grey mechanical device (looks like a printer or plotter). Overlay shows user "Alex &" and "**13 likes**".
*   **UI Elements on Tiles:**
    *   **Heart Icon:** Top-right corner of each tile for favoriting.
    *   **User Info:** Bottom-left corner showing a circular avatar and username.
    *   **Like Count:** Next to the username.

### 2. Pagination / Action Button
*   Centered below the gallery grid is a pill-shaped button labeled **"Load More"** with a downward chevron icon. It has a semi-transparent dark background.

### 3. Footer Section
The footer spans the full width with a dark, sophisticated background (deep charcoal/black gradient).
*   **Brand Column (Left):**
    *   **Logo:** "HYPER3D" in bold white text with a stylized icon.
    *   **Contact:** Email address "hello@deemos.com" in small grey text below the logo.
    *   **Social Icons:** A row of outline icons for X (Twitter), YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Discord, and Twitch.
*   **Navigation Columns:**
    *   **PRODUCT:** Links to "Rodin", "ChatAvatar".
    *   **FEATURES:** Links to "Text to 3D", "Image to 3D", "AI Video Generator", "AI Image Generator", "OmniCraft".
    *   **PLUG-INS:** Links to "Blender", "Unreal", "Unity", "Godot", "C4D", "Maya", "OV/Isaac".
    *   **LEGAL:** Links to "Privacy", "Terms".
*   **Copyright Bar:** At the very bottom left, small text reads: "© 2026 Deemos Corporation. All rights reserved".

### 4. Overlay Modal (Cookie Preferences)
A prominent white modal window is floating in the **bottom right corner**, overlaying the footer content.
*   **Header:** Bold text reading "**Cookie preferences**".
*   **Body Text:** Standard legal text explaining essential vs. optional cookies ("We use essential cookies...").
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Primary Button:** Purple/Violet solid button labeled "**Accept all**".
    *   **Secondary Button:** White/Grey outlined button labeled "**Preferences**".

### Background Atmosphere
The overall atmosphere is **dark mode, sleek, and tech-focused**. The background behind the gallery has a soft, blurry radial gradient (brownish/purple hues) that creates depth without distracting from the 3D models. The footer is flat and high-contrast for readability.
